Game-file reference · Lords and families

Plan your future court.

Compare personalities, starting renown, household troops, and family connections. Open a name for personal stats and the script rules behind its values.

New-game reference. Fixed definitions and possible initialization outcomes from the selected QoL Plus v2 module. Random personalities and families must be checked in your campaign; renown, marriages, and allegiance can change during play.

Click a column heading to sort. Check a name to keep it in your shortlist on this device.

Future vassals

Use personality to narrow the pool, then compare household troops, renown, and family reach. A variable lord appears in a personality filter when that result is possible; the filter does not establish his rolled personality in your save.

Marriage connections

For a male player, switch to Ladies and compare the father's or guardian's noble family. For a female player, filter Lords to unmarried at start, then inspect the same connections and personal stats. The selected module blocks marriage to Martial and Upstanding lords for a female player. Check each variable lord's rolled personality. Other courtship gates still apply.

Sources and limits

Extracted from installed game files, with no wiki lord table used as data. Family reach counts distinct noble relatives under the decoded rules; it is not a relation score, recruitment probability, or guaranteed political support. Household counts are script/template definitions, not a live party roster.
